description: Gradle 9.7.0 exposes its own lib/javaparser-core-3.27.1.jar on the system classloader (9.6.1 exposed it only on the Gradle API classloader).
kapt's annotation-processor classloader delegates parent-first, so Micronaut's Java processors link against that 3.27.1 instead of the 3.28.0 on the kapt classpath and :server:kaptKotlin fails with
NoSuchMethodError: StaticJavaParser.parseJavadoc(String, boolean) (javaparser 3.28.0 replaced the 1-arg overload that 3.27.1 provides).
Remove this rule once a Gradle release no longer leaks javaparser onto the system classloader — verify by flipping distributionUrl and running ./gradlew test.
